tasks.title: Row-wise maximum
tasks.statement: Print the larger value of each row.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 5], "b": [3, 2]})
print(df.max(axis=1).tolist())

tasks.title: Cumulative product
tasks.statement: Print the running product of the values.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

print(pd.Series([2, 3, 4]).cumprod().tolist())

tasks.title: Squared values
tasks.statement: Square every value and print the result.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([2, 3])
print((s ** 2).tolist())

tasks.title: Absolute gap between columns
tasks.statement: Print the absolute difference between the two columns.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [5, 1], "b": [2, 4]})
print((df["a"] - df["b"]).abs().tolist())

debug.title: The removed applymap
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
print(df.applymap(str).shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
print(df.map(str).shape)
debug.error: AttributeError: 'DataFrame' object has no attribute 'applymap'

debug.title: An axis named rows
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
print(df.agg("sum", axis=2))
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
print(df.agg("sum", axis=0).tolist())
debug.error: ValueError: No axis named 2 for object type DataFrame

debug.title: A column added from the wrong-length array
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2]})
df["b"] = df["a"].to_numpy() + [1, 2, 3]
print(df.shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2]})
df["b"] = df["a"].to_numpy() + [1, 2]
print(df.shape)
debug.error: ValueError: operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (2,) (3,)

debug.title: Subtracting frames with different columns
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

a = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1]})
b = pd.DataFrame({"y": [2]})
print(a.sub(b)["x"].tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

a = pd.DataFrame({"x": [1]})
b = pd.DataFrame({"x": [2]})
print(a.sub(b)["x"].tolist())
debug.error: Wrong output: [nan] — the labels do not overlap, so subtraction produces no aligned value.

tasks.title: Median absolute deviation
tasks.statement: Print the median absolute deviation from the median.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 10])
print((s - s.median()).abs().median())

tasks.title: Value counts in order
tasks.statement: Print the values ordered from most to least frequent.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["a", "b", "a"])
print(s.value_counts().index.tolist())

tasks.title: Index of the maximum
tasks.statement: Print the index label of the largest value.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([5, 9, 2])
print(s.idxmax())

tasks.title: Describe per group
tasks.statement: Describe the values per group and print the resulting shape.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"g": ["a", "a", "b"], "v": [1, 2, 3]})
print(df.groupby("g")["v"].describe().shape)

debug.title: A percentile written above one
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
print(s.describe(percentiles=[1.5]).shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
print(s.describe(percentiles=[0.5]).shape)
debug.error: ValueError: percentiles should all be in the interval [0, 1]

debug.title: A rank method that does not exist
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2])
print(s.rank(method="bad").tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2])
print(s.rank(method="first").tolist())
debug.error: KeyError: 'bad'

debug.title: median of a text column
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

print(pd.Series(["a", "b"]).median())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

print(pd.Series([1, 2]).median())
debug.error: TypeError: Cannot perform reduction 'median' with string dtype

debug.title: A correlation with a constant column
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 1, 1], "b": [1, 2, 3]})
print(round(float(df["a"].corr(df["b"])), 2))
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3], "b": [1, 2, 3]})
print(round(float(df["a"].corr(df["b"])), 2))
debug.error: Wrong output: nan — a constant column has no variation, so Pearson correlation is undefined.

tasks.title: Fill only the first gap
tasks.statement: Fill at most one gap and print the series.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([None, None, 3.0])
print(s.fillna(0, limit=1).tolist())

tasks.title: Drop columns that are empty
tasks.statement: Drop columns that are entirely missing and print the remaining names.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1.0], "b": [None]})
print(df.dropna(axis=1, how="all").columns.tolist())

tasks.title: Combine two partial series
tasks.statement: Fill the gaps of the first series from the second and print the result.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

a = pd.Series([1.0, None])
b = pd.Series([9.0, 2.0])
print(a.combine_first(b).tolist())

tasks.title: Missing count per column
tasks.statement: Print how many values are missing in each column.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, None], "b": [None, None]})
print(df.isna().sum().to_dict())

debug.title: A dropna rule that does not exist
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [None]})
print(df.dropna(how="sometimes").shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [None]})
print(df.dropna(how="any").shape)
debug.error: ValueError: invalid how option: sometimes

debug.title: Interpolating along a third axis
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1.0, None]})
print(df.interpolate(axis=2).shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1.0, None]})
print(df.interpolate(axis=0).shape)
debug.error: ValueError: No axis named 2 for object type DataFrame

debug.title: A limit direction that does not exist
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1.0, None, 3.0])
print(s.interpolate(limit_direction="sideways").tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1.0, None, 3.0])
print(s.interpolate(limit_direction="both").tolist())
debug.error: ValueError: Invalid limit_direction: expecting one of ['forward', 'backward', 'both'], got 'sideways'.

debug.title: A thresh that drops every row
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1.0, None], "b": [None, None]})
print(df.dropna(thresh=3).shape)
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1.0, None], "b": [None, None]})
print(df.dropna(thresh=1).shape)
debug.error: Wrong output: (0, 2) — thresh counts non-missing values per row, and no row has three.

tasks.title: Case-insensitive comparison
tasks.statement: Casefold the labels and print the unique values in order.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["Pune", "PUNE", "Goa"])
print(sorted(s.str.casefold().unique()))

tasks.title: Duplicates across two columns
tasks.statement: Count rows that repeat a pair of values.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 1, 2], "b": [1, 1, 2]})
print(int(df.duplicated(subset=["a", "b"]).sum()))

tasks.title: Winsorize by quantiles
tasks.statement: Clip the values to the 5th and 95th percentiles and print them.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3, 4, 100])
print(s.clip(s.quantile(0.05), s.quantile(0.95)).tolist())

tasks.title: Map booleans to labels
tasks.statement: Map True to yes and False to no, then print the labels.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"ok": [True, False]})
print(df["ok"].map({True: "yes", False: "no"}).tolist())

debug.title: A float cast that truncates silently
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1.9])
print(s.astype(int).tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1.9])
print(s.round().astype(int).tolist())
debug.error: Wrong output: [1] — astype(int) truncates toward zero instead of rounding.

debug.title: A rename whose result is assigned
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
df = df.rename(columns={"a": "b"}, inplace=True)
print(df.columns.tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1]})
df = df.rename(columns={"a": "b"})
print(df.columns.tolist())
debug.error: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'columns'

debug.title: duplicated given an axis argument
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 1]})
print(df.duplicated(axis=1).tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 1]})
print(df.duplicated().tolist())
debug.error: TypeError: DataFrame.duplicated() got an unexpected keyword argument 'axis'

debug.title: A z-score that used the wrong spread
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
z = (s - s.mean()) / s.std()
print(z.abs().round(2).tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([1, 2, 3])
z = (s - s.mean()) / s.std(ddof=0)
print(z.abs().round(2).tolist())
debug.error: Wrong output: [1.0, 0.0, 1.0] — the sample std (n-1) is larger, so these z-scores are smaller than the population ones.

tasks.title: Title case labels
tasks.statement: Title-case the labels and print them.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["pune city", "goa"])
print(s.str.title().tolist())

tasks.title: Strip punctuation
tasks.statement: Remove everything that is not a letter, digit or space, then print the labels.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["Pune!", "Goa?", "Mumbai."])
print(s.str.replace(r"[^A-Za-z0-9 ]", "", regex=True).tolist())

tasks.title: Pad to a fixed width
tasks.statement: Left-align the codes in a width of five characters and print them.
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["ab", "c"])
print(s.str.ljust(5, ".").tolist())

tasks.title: Either of two patterns
tasks.statement: Count the labels containing either "pur" or "del".
tasks.solution:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["Pune", "Nagpur", "Delhi"])
print(int(s.str.contains("pur|del", case=False).sum()))

debug.title: An unterminated character set
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["a"])
print(s.str.match(r"[").tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["a"])
print(s.str.match(r"[a-z]").tolist())
debug.error: re.error: unterminated character set at position 0

debug.title: A pad width passed as text
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["ab"])
print(s.str.pad(width="5").tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["ab"])
print(s.str.pad(width=5).tolist())
debug.error: TypeError: width must be of integer type, not str

debug.title: findall read as plain text
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["a1", "b2"])
print(s.str.findall(r"\d").tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["a1", "b2"])
print(s.str.extract(r"(\d)")[0].tolist())
debug.error: Wrong output: [['1'], ['2']] — findall returns a list per row, which is not a text column.

debug.title: A length taken as zero for a missing label
debug.broken:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["ab", None])
print(s.str.len().tolist())
debug.fix:
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series(["ab", None])
print(s.str.len().fillna(0).astype(int).tolist())
debug.error: Wrong output: [2.0, nan] — a missing label has no length, so it is NaN, not 0.
